data.title: The *trainer*
data.subtitle: The course lives in a project. The quiz is an artifact you can share.

blocks.text: Teaches a course or onboards new starters.
Keep materials in one place and make a quick quiz.

items: A **project** for the materials: **+ New Project**, **+** to add files
**Set project instructions** for level and tone
An **artifact** for the quiz: **Share → Who has access**

blocks.text: Using the session notes in this project, make a 10-question multiple-choice quiz as an interactive artifact, with a one-line explanation after each answer and a score.

items: A link to share on paid plans (Free: check your app)
